profile.classification: Game parameters only; selected frozen neural profile separate
profile.takeoff_rule: heading at neural onset plus seeded tangent jitter; stream 43; no hand input; reflect at arena boundary; land at current position
profile.round_clock: integer neural ticks; pauses during recorded replay; previous-held command drives interval; impact precedes newly decoded onset at same boundary
profile.change_reason: V2L owner-approved design v5: two input hands and longer flight only.

walking_drive.walk_stop: Stationary Bernoulli initial state; exponential dwell rounded up to 10 ms; seeded inverse CDF with logUnit

ou.rule: Exact 10 ms OU transition; unit Gaussian via Marsaglia polar and fixed 18-term range-reduced logUnit; turning current max(0, +/-OU) during walk; zero during stop

walking_drive.independence: Seed and integer interval only; no geometry, hand, cursor, aim, strike, body, callback or shared environment

copy.game: The wiring model does not walk on its own. The game adds a declared random drive to the walking neurons (game profile v2.9). Escape comes only from vision through the network.
copy.lab: Lab simulations have no walking drive.
copy.owner_choice: The walking setting was chosen by the author after playtesting four candidates that passed the same safety checks.

profile.physics_disclosure: Takeoff speed is an abstract body-physics game parameter, not a neural parameter. Flight duration scales to keep the path about six arena units. Walking, neural onset, direction, jitter and reflection are unchanged.
